messages:
lucy (AE): Heads-up: SentinelHealth wants a POC. Must-haves: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (Okta), RBAC mappings (fine-grained), domain ownership proof and Dedicated trial pricing. They also attached a 40-question security questionnaire. Can we cover before Wed kickoff?

omar (Solutions Eng): I can take SAML/SCIM runbook. Need IdP metadata XML, ACS/Entity URLs, and whether Okta will be source-of-truth. For SCIM bulk we support POST /scim/v2/Bulk (chunk <=2500) and CSV async import for >5k. Default rate limit 600/min per org.

paula (SE): Pricing: Recommend 2x-A10G equivalent, 14-day eval, token cap with overage flag. Add a one-time enablement fee for large bulk imports (48h lead). I'll draft quote.

jen (Security): On questionnaire: we can share SOC2 Type II, pen-test summary, and a dataflow diagram. For EU residency we can provision eu-west and include DPA excerpt. If they plan to send PHI, we need to escalate. We don't disclose HSM internals but describe KMS integration.

sara (Sales Ops): Domain verification: we support DNS TXT, SAML metadata verification, and API webhook. DNS TXT fastest for infra teams. Delegated admin: can scope to domains; list of allowed actions needed for legal.

lucy (AE): Action items: @omar prepare 1-page SAML+SCIM runbook + sample RBAC CSV, @jen assemble security pack + short answers, @paula finalize Dedicated trial quote, @sara prepare domain verification text for legal. I'll send presales pack to SentinelHealth EOD.

cal-bot: Meeting created "SentinelHealth POC Kickoff" 3 2025-05-28 16:00 UTC. Invitees: lucy, omar, paula, jen, sara. Link: https://cal.example/evt/SENT-POC

omar (Solutions Eng): Quick SCIM note to include in runbook:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
Rate-Limit: 600/min per org
Retry-After: 120s on 429
Bulk: POST /scim/v2/Bulk chunk <=2500, async job for >5k
```

paula (SE): Add optional import SLA: staging bucket provisioning 48h, live run scheduled with an engineer. Chargeable if repeated.

jen (Security): I'll redact any PII in our SOC2 before sharing and add a one-paragraph about key rotation and audit logs.

lucy (AE): Solid. If Okta bulk or PHI becomes a blocker, escalate to contracts/security. Otherwise pack ready. :thumbsup:
